notes.title: RC Cars is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and RC Cars is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - RC Cars, 20% off!
notes.content:
RC Cars is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

R.C. Cars is an exciting arcade racing game featuring the world of highly realistic toy radio controlled cars. Jump, accelerate, perform acrobatic feats in the air, and bounce on big hummocks, pits and bumps while contending with opponents for victory. Win prize money for placing in the race, purchase car upgrades and participate on further tracks!

*Offer ends April 30 at 10AM Pacific Time
